game_title: Name Tag Match – Postern Gate Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in The Kingdom – Postern Gate, the hidden postern gate: the squire must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Name Tag Match: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing arrows before they reach rogue crows.
theme: The Kingdom – Postern Gate: the hidden postern gate
core_gameplay_loop: In Postern Gate, repeat each round: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing arrows before they reach rogue crows. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the tag_matches value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about tag_matches to power up the squire and open the market bell.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 6 (applied tier): Name Tag Match
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
